prompt: Our Node.js/Express service powers two Grafana panels — an error-rate panel and a p95 latency panel — both fed by the `httpRequestsTotal` counter and `httpRequestDuration` histogram that `metricsMiddleware` below records, wired before every route and validation middleware.
